story:
Golden Business Machines, Inc. is the local leader in providing businesses of all sizes with office copiers, printers, software solutions, managed IT services and top-notch service throughout Northeastern and Central Pennsylvania — and has been for over 50 years.

Founded by Joseph R. Bradley in 1969, GBM is a locally owned business headquartered in Kingston, Pennsylvania, with branch sales and service offices in Edwardsville, Moosic, Hazleton and Williamsport. That footprint is the reason we can commit to having a technician on site within four hours, and the reason the decisions about your account are made by people who work in this valley. It is the kind of attention you cannot get from a larger corporation whose headquarters are somewhere else.

GBM has always been a leader, providing customers with trusted solutions to help their organizations prosper. We became one of Canon's first authorized dealers for office equipment in the nation, and were among this area's first Microsoft Solutions Providers. Our partnership with Hewlett Packard began with printers and expanded to include computers and servers. Understanding the marketplace has been the key to more than five decades of growth, success and industry leadership.

Today GBM is comprised of over 45 dedicated sales and service professionals with the expertise to provide our clients with the document solutions, print technology and IT infrastructure required in today's complex business environment — for healthcare, manufacturing, government, education, legal and non-profit organizations across the region.
